problem_refined.problem_refined: Campus career teams cannot reliably route local internships to students who can commute.
problem_refined.why_existing_solutions_fail: Availability and commute details become outdated.
problem_refined.opportunity_statement: Create a searchable local internship directory.

startup_idea.one_liner: A local internship directory maintained with career offices.
startup_idea.value_proposition: Find verified openings by commute and schedule.

market_trends: Career offices are testing more local partnerships.
assumptions: University students will start with internships near their campus.

personas.name: Commuter student
personas.quote: I need a placement I can reach between classes.

must_have_features.description: Filter by travel time and campus.

accessibility_notes: All search controls must be keyboard accessible.

mvp_roadmap.first_user_milestone: First student saves a verified listing.
mvp_success_criteria: A career office can publish its first verified listing.

pricing_strategy.pricing_philosophy: Free for students, paid for campus teams.

financial_projections.key_assumptions_note: Illustrative projection for the fixture workload.

risk_register.risk_summary: The first pilot depends on retaining employer listings.

tech_architecture.architecture_description: A browser UI submits work to an API with a durable worker queue.

database_schema.sql_schema: CREATE TABLE listings (id bigint PRIMARY KEY, title text NOT NULL);

owasp_top10_checklist.action: Check tenant ownership on private listings.

data_privacy_actions: Limit access to student contact details.

slides.title: Pilot plan
slides.headline: Start with one campus
bullet_points: Measure verified listings and student searches

executive_summary.executive_summary: Campus Route helps students find verified internships they can realistically commute to.
executive_summary.mission_statement: Make local internship opportunities easier to discover.
executive_summary.elevator_pitch: Give campus career offices a commuter-friendly placement directory.
